defects: Uses `Set.range_restrict f (Set.Icc a b) ⊆ Set.Icc a b`, but `Set.range_restrict` is a Mathlib *lemma* (an equality `Set.range (s.restrict f) = f '' s`), not a function producing a set — this expression does not typecheck / is not a valid way to state 'f maps the interval into itself' (should be `Set.MapsTo f (Set.Icc a b) (Set.Icc a b)` or `f '' Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.Icc a b`)
Specializes the gold's general ordered/topological setting (ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder, OrderTopology, DenselyOrdered α) to the concrete type ℝ, losing generality present in gold
Uses `Set.Icc a b` instead of gold's `uIcc a b` (unordered interval), and correspondingly adds an extra hypothesis `a ≤ b` that is not present in (and not needed by) the gold statement
Conclusion `f x = x` vs gold's `IsFixedPt f c` is only a defeq spelling difference, not a defect on its own, but combined with the above the statement is not a faithful match
